review_request.title: feat(gcw): fetch hosted remote evidence during verification
review_request.summary: Adds `remote_fetch.py` platform adapters (GitHub via `gh api`, GitLab via `glab`) and extends `verify_gcw_remote_evidence.py` so hosted gates can verify progress comments and review request bodies from `--issue-dir` alone. Preserves offline `--remote-file` mode; adds tests and hosted-agent documentation.

risks: Remote fetch requires `issues: read` and `pull-requests: read` token scopes in Actions; GitLab paths depend on `glab` authentication on the runner.
scope: Remote evidence verification scripts and docs only; no hosted workflow YAML changes in this PR.
reviewer_notes: Confirm `--remote-file` regression tests still pass and that fetch errors surface actionable messages for auth/404/unsupported URL shapes.
